## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint topic — Authentication, output, revisions and AI usage guides.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint topic COMMAND [ARGS] [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Choose a subcommand, then inspect its exact --help before execution.

SUBCOMMANDS
  authentication      Configure Sprint sessions, profiles and private automation-token files.
  automation          Discover commands and connect AI agents through CLI or MCP.
  output              Understand JSON results, pagination, stderr and exit codes.
  revisions           Use revision guards and operation keys without retrying mutations blindly.

EXAMPLES
  sprint topic authentication --help

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

SEE ALSO
  sprint help
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/topic.md
```
